title: Build Your Personal Toolkit
subtitle: Different situations may call for different tools.
description: Choose strategies that you have tried, understand, and can use safely. A toolkit supports individualized care; it does not replace assessment or clinical advice.

fields.label: When symptoms are calm, what helps you build capacity?
When symptoms increase, what helps you stay engaged without overdoing it?
What supports your sleep, stress, mood, or energy?
When should you ask your practitioner for guidance?

successMessage: Toolkit saved. Keep refining it as you learn what works in different situations.
